cases.sentence: Стоявшие там ___ спросили, «Что вы делаете? Зачем отвязываете осленка?»
cases.translation: Some of those standing there asked, "What are you doing, untying the donkey?"
cases.explain: Люди is the subject of спросили (asked), so it stands in the nominative plural.

cases.sentence: На следующий день, когда они вышли из ___, Иисус почувствовал голод.
cases.translation: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, Jesus felt hungry.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) takes the genitive → Вифании.

cases.sentence: Тогда Иисус сказал ___, «Пусть же никто никогда больше не ест твоих плодов».
cases.translation: Then Jesus said to the tree, "May no one ever eat fruit from you again."
cases.explain: Сказать кому-то (to say to someone/something) takes the dative → дереву.

cases.sentence: Иисус вошел в ___ и стал выгонять оттуда продающих и покупающих.
cases.translation: Jesus entered the temple and began to drive out those who were selling and buying.
cases.explain: В (into) marking motion takes the accusative; since храм is inanimate, the accusative matches the nominative → храм.

cases.sentence: «Дом мой будет назван ___ молитвы для всех народов», — учил он их.
cases.translation: "My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations," he taught them.
cases.explain: The predicate complement after назван (named/called) takes the instrumental → домом.

cases.sentence: Они снова пришли в Иерусалим, и когда Иисус ходил в ___, к нему подошли первосвященники, учители закона и старейшины.
cases.translation: They came again to Jerusalem, and as Jesus was walking in the temple, the chief priests, teachers of the law and elders came to him.
cases.explain: В (in) marking a static location (no motion) takes the prepositional → храме.

reading.ru: Когда они приблизились к Вифагии и Вифании, селением, расположенным у Масличной горы, неподалеку от Иерусалима, Иисус послал вперед двух учеников.
reading.question: What did Jesus do as they approached Bethphage and Bethany?
reading.explain: As they neared Bethphage and Bethany, Jesus sent two of his disciples ahead.

reading.ru: И сразу же, как только войдете, вы найдете привязанного осленка, на которого еще никто не садился.
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the disciples they would find in the village?
options: A young donkey that no one had ridden
reading.correct: A young donkey that no one had ridden
reading.explain: Jesus said they would find a tied young donkey that no one had yet sat on.

reading.ru: И те, кто шел впереди, и те, кто шел позади, громко кричали, «Ассанна, благословен тот, кто приходит во имя Господа!»
reading.question: What did the crowd shout as Jesus entered Jerusalem?
options: "Hosanna, blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord"
reading.correct: "Hosanna, blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord"
reading.explain: Those going ahead and behind cried out, "Hosanna, blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!"

reading.ru: Тогда Иисус сказал дереву, «Пусть же никто никогда больше не ест твоих плодов».
reading.question: What did Jesus say to the fig tree that had no fruit?
options: May no one ever eat your fruit again
You will bear fruit again next year
I will cut you down today
Give your fruit to the poor
reading.correct: May no one ever eat your fruit again
reading.explain: Finding no fruit on it, Jesus told the tree that no one would ever eat its fruit again.

reading.ru: «Дом мой будет назван домом молитвы для всех народов», — учил он их. «А вы превратили его в разбойничье логово».
reading.question: What did Jesus say the temple should be, and what had it become?
options: A house of prayer, but it had become a den of robbers
A marketplace, and it had become a school
A courtroom, and it had become a palace
A treasury, and it had become empty
reading.correct: A house of prayer, but it had become a den of robbers
reading.explain: Jesus taught that his house should be a house of prayer, but they had turned it into a den of robbers.

reading.ru: Петр вспомнил, что произошло накануне, и сказал, «Рабби, смотри, инжир, который ты проклял, засох».
reading.question: What did Peter point out to Jesus the next morning?
options: The fig tree Jesus had cursed had withered
reading.correct: The fig tree Jesus had cursed had withered
reading.explain: Peter remembered the cursed fig tree and pointed out that it had withered away.

reading.ru: И когда вы молитесь, то прощайте всем, на кого вы обижены, чтобы и ваш Небесный Отец простил вам ваши проступки.
reading.question: What does Jesus say you must do when you pray, so your Father will forgive you?
options: Forgive anyone you have something against
reading.correct: Forgive anyone you have something against
reading.explain: Jesus teaches that when you pray, you must forgive those who have wronged you, so your Heavenly Father will forgive you.

reading.ru: Иисус сказал, «тогда и я вам не скажу, чьей властью я все это делаю».
reading.question: How did Jesus respond when the religious leaders refused to answer about John's baptism?
options: He refused to tell them by what authority he acted
He performed a miracle to prove his authority
reading.correct: He refused to tell them by what authority he acted
reading.explain: Since they would not answer about John, Jesus in turn refused to say by what authority he acted.
